meta.scope: Vietnam Batch 4 — Mekong Delta regional profile, tourism, climate/NDC, and social insurance / health insurance coverage.

candidates.title: Mekong Delta regional economic and agricultural profile
candidates.publisher: Derived from GSO and agricultural sources
candidates.description: System-level view of the Mekong Delta — Vietnam’s primary rice bowl and major aquaculture region. Produces the majority of national rice, a large share of fruit and fisheries output; faces climate and salinity challenges.
candidates.notes: Southern agricultural heartland spatial node. Complements the northern industrial Red River Delta.

candidates.title: Aquaculture and fisheries production statistics
candidates.publisher: General Statistics Office / Ministry of Agriculture related
candidates.description: Official volume and value statistics for aquaculture and capture fisheries. Vietnam is a major global seafood exporter; the Mekong Delta dominates production.

candidates.title: International visitor arrivals and tourism statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism / GSO related
candidates.description: Official statistics on international tourist arrivals, source markets and related tourism indicators. Arrivals have recovered strongly and set new records in recent years.

candidates.title: Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) and climate-policy framework
candidates.description: Vietnam’s NDC under the Paris Agreement and associated climate-policy framing. Continuously referenced in energy, agriculture, forestry and adaptation discussions.
referenced_by: Energy mix and Power Development Plan

candidates.title: Greenhouse gas emissions inventory and statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment / related
candidates.description: National GHG inventory results by sector (energy dominant, followed by agriculture and industrial processes). Provides the empirical base for NDC tracking.

candidates.title: Health insurance coverage statistics
candidates.description: Official coverage rates for the national health insurance scheme. Coverage has reached very high levels (above 90 % of the population in recent years).

candidates.title: Social insurance and unemployment insurance coverage
candidates.description: Coverage statistics for compulsory social insurance and unemployment insurance among the labour force. Complements health-insurance coverage and forms the core of the formal social-security system.

candidates.title: Vietnam Mekong–tourism–climate–social-protection densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from GSO, tourism, climate and VSS sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding Mekong Delta regional profile, aquaculture/fisheries, tourism arrivals, NDC climate framework, GHG inventory, health insurance coverage and social insurance coverage into a coherent southern-spatial, services, climate and social-protection layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
